title: Design System: Wakil AI — Store Directory

display.purpose: Root and category h1; mobile role applies up to 767px.

components.name: Category card
components.description: Same-tab category grid link with a 58px symbol aligned to name/count and a decorative arrow hidden up to 400px.
components.html:
Home Goods

1 store
components.css: .ds-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr) 20px;align-items:center;align-content:center;column-gap:24px;min-height:144px;padding:24px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#111);border:1px solid var(--border,#e8e4de);border-radius:16px;text-decoration:none}.ds-card:hover{border-color:var(--orange,#ff6b00);background:var(--panel,#ff6b00)}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#111);outline-offset:5px}.ds-card>div{min-width:0}.ds-card h3{font-family:"Space Grotesk",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:28px;letter-spacing:-.005em;margin:0 0 8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-card p{font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:22px;color:var(--muted,rgba(17,17,17,.75));margin:0}.ds-icon{position:relative;align-self:stretch;width:58px;min-height:58px;color:var(--primary,#a04100)}.ds-icon svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}.ds-card:hover .ds-icon{color:var(--ink,#111)}.ds-arrow{width:20px;height:20px;margin-left:auto}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-card{min-height:112px;padding:20px}}@media(max-width:400px){.ds-card{grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr)}.ds-arrow{display:none}}

components.name: Store-name search
components.description: Root searches all store names; category pages search only their stores. Runtime adds clear action, polite result count and distinct empty states.
components.css: .ds-search{max-width:720px;font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#111)}.ds-search label{display:block;font-family:"Space Grotesk",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:12px}.ds-field{position:relative}.ds-field>svg{position:absolute;left:20px;top:20px;width:24px;height:24px;color:var(--primary,#a04100);pointer-events:none}.ds-field input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;height:64px;padding:16px 64px 16px 56px;font:inherit;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#111);border:1px solid var(--border,#e8e4de);border-radius:8px;caret-color:var(--primary,#a04100)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,rgba(17,17,17,.75))}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#111);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: The supplied Wakil AI brand system remains the reference for geometric typography and orange. The user’s explicit orange canvas with white cards supersedes its white-first rule. Scope is the English root and eleven category pages; independent store pages retain local brands and French copy. The centered root heading reads NFC Store Links without an intro or upper directory label.
keyCharacteristics: Wakil Orange canvas, white cards and delicate borders.
Self-hosted Space Grotesk headings/navigation and Plus Jakarta Sans body.
58px category symbols aligned to name/count, proportioned store logos and whole-card navigation.

rules.name: The Orange Canvas Rule
rules.body: Keep the shared directory canvas orange and cards white at rest; this confirmed override supersedes white-first brand guidance.

dos: Do apply the shared system only to directory pages.
Do preserve supplied logos and visible keyboard focus.
Do let content wrap and scroll naturally.
Do keep store types in root search results and omit locations from every card.
donts: Don't propagate directory branding into store pages.
Don't crop, recolor or fabricate logos, or add location labels to directory cards.
Don't add shadows or motion absent from the implementation.
